import java.util.Scanner;
public class p723b{
	public static void main(String []args){
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = in.nextInt();
		String s = in.next();
		int lw,wi,w,j;
		boolean _in=false;
		lw=wi=w=0;
		j=-1;
		for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){
			char c=s.charAt(i);
			if(c=='_' && !_in && lw<i-j-1){
				lw = i-j-1;
			}
			if(c=='_' && _in && i-j>1){
				wi++;
			}
			if(c=='('){
				_in = true;
				if(lw<i-j-1)lw=i-j-1;
			}
			if(c==')'){
				_in = false;
				if(i-j>1)wi++;
			}
			if(c=='_' || c=='(' || c ==')')
				j=i;
		}
		if(lw<s.length()-j-1)lw=s.length()-j-1;
		System.out.println(lw+" "+wi);
	}
}
